verified_facts.text: The hotel's spa is Asaya Spa by Guerlain, combining French refinement with holistic wellness.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step into Asaya Spa by Guerlain, where French refinement meets holistic wellness in the heart of Hong Kong.

verified_facts.text: The Legacy House is a MICHELIN Guide Hong Kong Macau one-star restaurant for 2024 to 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: MICHELIN Guide Hong Kong Macau one-star restaurant 2024 - 2026

verified_facts.text: CHAAT is a MICHELIN Guide Hong Kong Macau one-star restaurant for 2022 to 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: MICHELIN Guide Hong Kong Macau one-star restaurant 2022 - 2026

verified_facts.text: The Legacy House is a Cantonese restaurant overlooking Victoria Harbour that celebrates the culinary traditions of Guangdong province.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking Victoria Harbour, this Cantonese restaurant celebrates culinary traditions from China's Guangdong province.

verified_facts.text: CHAAT serves refined Indian cuisine inspired by India's street food and homemade classics.
verified_facts.excerpt: Refined Indian cuisine inspired by the vibrant street food and homemade classics of India.

verified_facts.text: The Butterfly Room serves afternoon tea surrounded by butterfly art by Damien Hirst.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savour a glamorous afternoon tea and refined savoury bites at this award-winning destination, surrounded by breathtaking butterfly art by Damien Hirst.

verified_facts.text: BluHouse serves Italian food and donates 1% of revenue to support underserved groups in the neighbouring community.
verified_facts.excerpt: Taste the vibrant flavors of Italy at BluHouse. A 'business with purpose', 1% of revenue is donated to support underserved groups in the neighbouring community.

verified_facts.text: Bayfare Social serves Spanish cuisine and has a terrace with a view of Victoria Harbour.
verified_facts.excerpt: Serving delectable Spanish cuisine made from fresh seasonal fare. Enjoy the magnificent view of Hong Kong's Victoria Harbour from the terrace.

verified_facts.text: DarkSide is a cocktail parlour with rare aged spirits and a live jazz band.
verified_facts.excerpt: A cocktail parlour of rare aged spirits, award winning cocktails and a sultry live jazz band.

verified_facts.text: Holt's Cafe is a contemporary take on Hong Kong's traditional Cha Chaan Teng, serving local and international cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: traditional Cha Chaan Teng with comforting local and international cuisine set in a stylish parlour

verified_facts.text: HENRY is a grill and bar with a modern, ingredient-led approach.
verified_facts.excerpt: The traditional grill experience reimagined with a modern, ingredient-led approach that transcends the classic steakhouse.

verified_facts.text: Marmo Bistro serves classic French cuisine with the warmth of a neighbourhood brasserie.
verified_facts.excerpt: With the warmth of a neighbourhood brasserie, Marmo Bistro invites you to savour the beauty of classic French cuisine.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's Cultural Ambassador curates bespoke itineraries, from temples and historical architecture to the local dining scene.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether you’re looking for spiritual temples and historical architecture, or the taste of the local dining scene, allow our Cultural Ambassador to curate your bespoke itinerary.

verified_facts.text: Suites come with personalised butler service and Manor Club access.
verified_facts.excerpt: with a total of 91 suites enhanced by personalised butler service and Manor Club access

verified_facts.text: Rosewood Residences offer studios and multi-floor apartments for extended stays, with views of the waterfront and Kowloon Peak.
verified_facts.excerpt: Soaring high above Victoria Harbour, with dramatic views of the waterfront and Kowloon Peak, Rosewood Residences offer 186 tastefully designed studios and multi-floor apartments that cater to extended stays.

verified_facts.text: Asaya occupies an entire floor of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Asaya, occupying an entire floor, describes itself as an "integrated wellness concept,"

verified_facts.text: The spa floor also has a harbor-facing gym, an infinity pool and a Rossano Ferretti HairSpa.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the same floor, you'll find a harbor-facing gym, 25-metre infinity pool, and Rossano Ferretti HairSpa.

verified_facts.text: Guests can stay overnight in an Asaya Lodge.
verified_facts.excerpt: The option to stay overnight in a tranquil Asaya Lodge is a clever addition.

verified_facts.text: Asaya offers a face and body massage performed with calligraphy brushes, inspired by Chinese culture.
verified_facts.excerpt: plus two exclusive treatments inspired by Chinese culture—like a face and body massage performed with gentle calligraphy brushes

verified_facts.text: The metro and ferries are close to the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Both the metro and ferries are more or less on the doorstep.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is near the Hong Kong Museum of Art, the harborfront promenade and K11 Musea.
verified_facts.excerpt: the nearby Hong Kong Museum of Art and the harborfront promenade revamped, as well as the advent of K11 Musea

verified_facts.text: The hotel's owners, the Cheng family, originally came from Shunde in mainland China.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Cheng family owners originally came from Shunde in mainland China.

verified_facts.text: Bath amenities, by Votary, change with the seasons.
verified_facts.excerpt: That the soaps (Votary) and similar amenities change with the seasons

verified_facts.text: The hotel's address is 18 Salisbury Road, Hong Kong.
verified_facts.excerpt: No18, Salisbury Rd, Hong Kong

verified_facts.text: In-room dining is available at any time, with Hong Kong classics and international favourites.
verified_facts.excerpt: No matter the time, our carefully curated In-Room Dining menu can immerse you in local flavours from iconic Hong Kong classics to the comforting taste of home with perennial international favourites
